g.text: P120: separate and required inline checkpoints
Four known development tasks; one run per condition. All eight slots retained. Cached input counts as input.
All checkpoint instructions, schema and output are charged. Summary costs include rejected summaries. Unknown use is not zero; missing slots are not free runs.
Required schema does not establish actual installation. Lower cost alone does not establish preserved quality. Ordinary-control comparison.
